source_caption_text:
#BoosieBadazz gets emotional as he opens up about the recent arrests of both of his sons, sharing a heartbreaking message about how much the situation has affected him as a father.

In an emotional moment, Boosie expressed that he feels like the devil couldn’t get to him directly, so he went after his children instead. His words have sparked conversations about the pain parents experience when their children find themselves facing difficult situations, regardless of how much guidance, love, or protection they try to provide.

For Boosie, this is clearly more than just a headline or another situation playing out in the public eye. These are his children, and watching both of his sons deal with legal troubles is something no father wants to experience.
